item.dc:creator: MyEtherWallet (MEW)
item.content:encoded:
Our Medium channels will no longer be updated or maintained — visit our official blog instead!

Dear readers and MEW users!

Thank you for reading and following our official MyEtherWallet (MEW) Medium publication over the years! You may have noticed that we have stopped publishing to Medium — this is because we are no longer monitoring or maintaining this channel, and have focused our efforts on the MyEtherWallet blog hosted on our official website at https://www.myetherwallet.com/.

The posts on this channel remain available for reference, but keep in mind that they are not being updated and many are out of date.

For our latest articles, guides, and announcements, here’s where to find us:

MyEtherWallet blog: our current home for news and education about crypto and tokenized finance

Website: myetherwallet.com

Help Center: help.myetherwallet.com

X (Twitter): @myetherwallet

Other social channels: You’ll find our full, verified list of social and community channels linked directly on myetherwallet.com

A quick security reminder while we have your attention: always reach us through the official links on our website, bookmark the MEW pages you use, and remember that MEW will never message you first or ask for your wallet access information.

If you ever need help or have any questions for us, email us at support@myetherwallet.com.

Thanks for reading — and see you on our blog!

Team MEW

item.dc:creator: MyEtherWallet (MEW)

Self-Custody Your SOL in MEW Mobile

MEW Mobile now supports Solana! Import your SOL and hold all your crypto securely in your favorite wallet.

This Medium publication is not being actively updated or maintained, and the article below may be outdated.
For the latest posts, see our official blog at https://www.myetherwallet.com/blog.
For help and any questions about MEW products, email support@myetherwallet.com.

Since launching 10 years ago as the first Ethereum wallet, MEW has been committed to supporting easy, secure, and self-custodial access to the blockchain for anyone in the world.

Having earned the trust of of the community as the most reliable wallet for Ethereum, over the years MEW has added support for other networks that have been time-tested and have provided value to users. Polygon, BNB Smart Chain, Arbitrum, Optimism, Base, zkSync, and even Bitcoin are supported in MEW mobile wallet, and today MEW is adding Solana.

Solana is a proof of stake network launched in 2020 that has fostered a unique and vibrant community, and has recently emerged as one of the leading blockchains for stablecoins, RWA (real world asset) tokenization, and onchain payment systems. It supports SOL staking, and is home to some of the most popular applications in crypto, including Raydium, Jupiter, Meteora, and PumpFun.

To start using Solana in MEW, import your SOL from other wallets using our detailed guides or buy SOL in MEW directly, and hold all your crypto in one secure, user-friendly wallet that you love!

MEW is always adding new networks and features — if there is something specific you’d like to see in your MEW wallet, make sure to follow us on X(Twitter) and let us know your thoughts! Sign up for our newsletter to stay up to date with MEW releases, and check out our weekly podcast Crypto Currents for the latest news in crypto.

item.title: MEW Mobile: Self Custody Multichain Wallet for Ethereum, Arbitrum, Base, Polygon and More
item.dc:creator: MyEtherWallet (MEW)

For help and any questions about MEW products, email support@myetherwallet.com.

MyEtherWallet started in 2015 as an Ethereum-only wallet, but even then, the main motivation for the MEW team was to create easy, secure, and well-designed blockchain tools for everyday, non-expert users.

Nine years later, the space is unrecognizable, with dozens, if not hundreds of blockchains building to provide scalability for the Ethereum ecosystem. Ethereum supplies the underlying security and continues to be the home for original DeFi solutions, and Layer 2s offer the much-needed lower transaction fees and higher speeds which are imperative for blockchain scaling.

MEW Mobile wallet app allows users to manage their assets on the go, with a level of security that is surpassed only by hardware wallets. In addition to Ethereum, the support of Layer 2 networks like Polygon, Base, BNB Smart Chain, and zkSync gives users the flexibility for buying and selling crypto, bridging, and swapping right from their phone, without ever missing a crypto opportunity again.

Today, MEW Mobile wallet app is adding support for Artbitrum, one of the most popular Layer 2 networks. Users can buy, swap and bridge crypto to Arbitrum, manage Arbitrum NFTs and use Arbitrum dApps right from the wallet’s in-app browser.

Download MEW Mobile app and start using Arbitrum for faster, cheaper transactions and trades. Let us know what you think on X (Twitter) or Reddit, and contact our support@myetherwallet.com if you have any questions!

The first step in starting your crypto journey is getting a crypto wallet — preferably, a secure, self custody, open source wallet. MEW has you covered there, with great mobile and browser options, as well as a MEW Portfolio dashboard where you can connect and manage assets on any wallet.

The next step is actually getting some crypto. MEW has you covered there too, with multiple onboarding providers integrated right in the wallet — including Simplex, MoonPay, Coinbase Onramp, and now, Topper by Uphold. More onramping choices means better rates and less issues with purchases for users, which makes crypto more accessible for everyone.

Uphold is a global web3 financial platform that’s been around for a decade — a real OG in the crypto space, just like MyEtherWallet. Topper is Uphold’s fiat-to-crypto onramp, offering MEW users a quick, secure, and reliable way to purchase ETH and tokens without leaving the wallet.

Best of all, for a limited time, MEW and Topper are celebrating the launch by offering crypto purchases with zero fees for all users!

Buy Crypto using MEW Mobile

MEW Mobile is MEW’s wallet app for iOS and Android. If you don’t have MEW Mobile, download the app, create or import your wallet, and buy crypto in the app with just a few clicks, selecting Topper from the providers. Need help? See our detailed help center guide.

Buy Crypto using Enkrypt

Our multichain browser wallet Enkrypt supports over 70 natively integrated networks, and with Topper’s wide selection of crypto available for purchase, you’ll be spoilt for choice. Download Enkrypt here, if you don’t have it already, and follow this guide for buying crypto right from the wallet.

Buy Crypto using MEW Portfolio

MEW Portfolio allows you to buy crypto to any wallet in just a few steps. Click ‘Buy Crypto’ on top of the myetherwallet.com page, choose your preferred payment currency, select your desired network and token, and enter your wallet address (you can even put in your ENS domain name, for extra insurance against address errors). Alternatively, access your wallet on MEW Portfolio and buy crypto from your MEW dashboard. Make sure to pick Topper from the providers for zero fees on your purchase! See our help center for more information.

item.title: ETH Staking Powered by Coinbase Now Available in MEW
item.dc:creator: MyEtherWallet (MEW)
item.content:encoded:
This Medium publication is not being actively updated or maintained, and the article below may be outdated.
For the latest posts, see our official blog at https://www.myetherwallet.com/blog.
For help and any questions about MEW products, email support@myetherwallet.com.

ETH staking is one of the simplest ways to earn rewards in crypto, and yet, it still doesn’t have the attention or the adoption it deserves.

Memecoins going 500x and airdrop farming are what crypto natives get excited about. While these opportunities give some crypto holders FOMO, they scare most people away, since too many 500x’s end up being rugpulls.

Meanwhile, ETH staking — low-risk and requiring no maintenance when done via a staking service — could be exactly what crypto newbies need. The problem is that it’s still too difficult and inaccessible for many users. Either the required amount is too high (32 ETH for a full validator!), or the process is too complicated, or you can’t do it from your wallet and have to create an account on a different platform. Simpler solutions need to exist to introduce more ETH holders to staking.

Coinbase has been making crypto onboarding and trading easy for over ten years, and now it’s helping users stake ETH without leaving their favorite self-custody wallet. MyEtherWallet was the first Ethereum wallet, making ETH accessible to non-technical users for the first time in 2015, and it’s one of the first wallets to integrate ETH staking powered by Coinbase.

This integration makes staking more convenient and approachable than it’s ever been.

  • There is no minimum amount, and the stake begins earning rewards right away, compounding automatically.
  • The ETH can be unstaked and re-staked at any time.
  • Users of any popular wallet — including all browser wallets, mobile wallets with WalletConnect, and hardware wallets like Ledger and Trezor — can use MEW web to stake ETH quickly and easily, while retaining custody of their assets.
  • All staking operations happen onchain via audited smart contracts, with transactions that are verifiable on the blockchain. It’s the kind of transparency and decentralized security that users of self-custody wallets expect.

To start staking today, go to MyEtherWallet.com, connect your wallet, and select ‘ETH Staking: Powered by Coinbase’ on the dApp page. See our help center for more information: https://help.myetherwallet.com/en/articles/8843926-stake-eth-with-coinbase-in-mew-web

Don’t have a wallet yet? Create a mobile or browser wallet on MEW in minutes.

item.title: MEW Wallet Integrates Coinbase Pay
item.dc:creator: MyEtherWallet (MEW)
item.content:encoded:
Onboarding into self-custody has never been easier

This Medium publication is not being actively updated or maintained, and the article below may be outdated.
For the latest posts, see our official blog at https://www.myetherwallet.com/blog.
For help and any questions about MEW products, email support@myetherwallet.com.

In crypto, we talk a lot about adoption. We talk about onboarding, onramping, lowering the barriers to entry, improving UX/UI, and making better educational content.

The truth is, as with any new endeavor, a person’s experience with crypto is a journey. There’s exploration, growth, and reflection, but the way it starts can strongly determine how it continues — or doesn’t.

Welcome to Crypto

For many crypto users in the US the beginning of their journey is Coinbase. Easy, safe, with a simple interface, and a clear statement of purpose, it is the onboarding experience the crypto-curious were looking for — over 100 million of them, and counting.

Some of these millions just wanted a little piece of the crypto pie, and are happy with what they have achieved on a custodial platform. Others are continuing their journey by getting educated about self-custody: what it means, why it matters in crypto, and how it can fit into their overall crypto strategy.

Level Up

Self-custodial wallets like MEW give users full control over assets, but also require a lot of responsibility and a willingness to do independent research. Crypto moves fast, and a self-custodial wallet which supports Ethereum and Layer 2s is often the only way to get access to exciting new projects or tokens.

Exploring web3 without limits is a great adventure, but it comes with its own challenges. For example, how do you get the crypto you want into your self-custodial wallet, since it’s not directly connected to a centralized exchange? Either you’d have to do KYC through an onboarding provider, which can take time, or send the assets from an exchange wallet account, which will cost some transaction fees.

The Big Win

What if, instead of increasing confusion, the separate pieces of the crypto journey lined up perfectly and complemented each other?

That’s what happens when a self-custodial wallet like MEW integrates a fast, secure, easy, and widely adopted payment option like Coinbase Pay.

The great start you got on Coinbase is serving you well on your continued crypto journey. Need some ETH for gas to play around with a new dApp? Just click a button and buy your ETH with your Coinbase account, deposited right into your MEW wallet app.

Heard about a token that can be used with a cool DeFi platform? Buy it with one click and head to the in-app browser. And if you ever want to swap these tokens, you can do that right in the app too, through MEW’s integrated DEX providers.

The easiest way to onramp into crypto

Overall, Coinbase Pay offers 100+ cryptocurrencies for purchase, accepting over 60 fiat currencies and multiple payment methods, including debit cards and bank accounts. Don’t have a Coinbase Pay account yet? No problem. You can create one right from MEW wallet app and use it across the ecosystem, everywhere Coinbase Pay is accepted.

In the crypto space, big centralized platforms like Coinbase can provide the much-needed structural security and stability, while self-custodial wallets like MEW expand the possibilities of crypto by giving access to dApps, games, tokens, NFTs, and new projects that pop up every day.

Self-custody means that you are the only one who has access to your crypto, and your decisions about it don’t require permission from anyone. There are no rules to follow, but also no guardrails to fence you in.

Which crypto journey are you on? The nice and steady, or the wild ride? Enjoy the best of both worlds with Coinbase Pay in MEW wallet. That’s how adoption happens.

item.title: Mint a free RNS Domain on MEW for a Chance to Win $500 in rBTC
item.dc:creator: MyEtherWallet (MEW)
item.content:encoded:
This Medium publication is not being actively updated or maintained, and the article below may be outdated.
For the latest posts, see our official blog at https://www.myetherwallet.com/blog.
For help and any questions about MEW products, email support@myetherwallet.com.

We’ve come a long way in crypto over the past few years: interfaces are looking better, fees are getting lower on layer 2s and sidechains, and there are lots of wallets and DApps to choose from. Still, crypto can be hard, so it makes sense to take advantage of any trick that will make it safer and easier.

Blockchain domain names are a no-brainer for enhancing your crypto experience. They help you — and, even more importantly, the people who are paying you — avoid sending crypto to the wrong address.

Plus, they are a cool way to show off your personality on the blockchain. Domains are worth every penny. And when you’re not just getting a free domain, but also a chance to win $500? Run, don’t walk.

What’s an RNS domain?

Blockchain domains assign an email-like name to your wallet address, so that people can send money to ‘mycoolwallet.rsk’ rather than an error-prone string of numbers and letters.

RIF Name Service is a blockchain domain provider that secures domains through the Rootstock network. Rootstock is the smart contract platform for Bitcoin, compatible with the Ethereum Virtual Machine (EVM) and supported on MEW. The native currency of Rootstock, rBTC, is pegged 1:1 with Bitcoin.

Your RNS domain can be used across all major blockchains including Bitcoin, Bitcoin Cash, Litecoin, Ethereum, Dogecoin, XRP, and more! You can have one wallet name for all your currencies and never worry about keeping different blockchain addresses straight again.

How to mint your domain and enter the raffle

Starting Saturday, September 16th, you should register your wallet address on the RNS campaign page so that you will be whitelisted for the rBTC/RIF faucet.

Make sure to register by 11.59pm PT, Wednesday, September 20th.

Starting at 10am PT, Wednesday, September 20th, go to the faucet page (find link on the bottom of the registration page), put in the same address from before, and click ‘Get RBTC and RIF’.

Once you receive the assets from the faucet, you can mint a free RNS domain on MEW web by 11.59pm PT, Sunday, September 24th, and be automatically entered into a raffle to win $500 in rBTC.

Here are the detailed steps:

1: Make sure you’re following us on Twitter so you see the announcement of the campaign.

2: Retweet the Twitter post when you see it.

3: Visit the campaign landing page from the link in the Twitter post or from here: https://rnsgiveaway.myetherwallet.com/

4: Enter your wallet address into the form. Use the address of the wallet that you will be connecting to MEW web to mint the domain. If you’re not sure if your wallet will support transactions on Rootstock, consider downloading our multichain browser wallet Enkrypt. Make sure to do this by 11.59pm PT, Wednesday, September 20th.

5: Starting Wednesday, September 20th, visit the faucet link that you’ll find at the bottom of the campaign landing page and submit your wallet address (the same one that you put on the landing page form earlier). Click ‘Get RBTC and RIF’. You will receive the correct amount of rBTC and RIF to cover minting costs and gas costs, so that you are getting the domain completely free!

6: After getting the faucet funds, go to MEW web and connect your wallet. See the following article for assistance: How to access your wallet on MEW web

7: Switch the network to Rootstock on the top right of the page. Check that your balance shows rBTC and RIF received from the faucet.

8: Select Apps from the dashboard menu on the left. Click on ‘RNS manager’, search for a name that you like, and follow the prompts to register the domain. Once you mint the RNS, you’ll be entered into the raffle automatically!

9: The RNSxMEW campaign runs through Sunday, September 24th, so make sure to mint your domain by that time, and then keep an eye on our Twitter for the winners!

That’s why MEW is continuously working to offer multiple ways to buy crypto easily and securely, right in the wallet. Today, we are excited to announce the integration of Link by Stripe for ETH purchases in MEW wallet app.

Link is a payments solution created by Stripe to make online purchases completely seamless across thousands of sites, businesses, and marketplaces. We believe that onramping into crypto should be as quick and painless as possible, so you can get on with the fun stuff of web3. If you have used Link by Stripe elsewhere online, you can enjoy a one-click ETH purchase in MEW wallet right out of the gate. Even if you’re new to Link, the account setup takes just a few minutes, and all your future purchases will be pretty much instant.

Link by Stripe supports payments with credit card, debit card, and bank account. To purchase ETH using Link in MEW wallet app, click on your account card, select Buy ETH, choose how much you want to spend, and select Link from the available providers.
